commands: echo "run_id=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} attempt=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none} actions=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-none}"; git status --porcelain | head -20; echo "---status-end---"

gh pr diff 1308 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1308/30969695806-1/diff.patch
wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1308/30969695806-1/diff.patch
grep '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1308/30969695806-1/diff.patch

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
ls .changeset/*.md 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---sample---"; for f in $(ls .changeset/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v hook-arm | head -2); do echo "== $f =="; sed -n '1,6p' "$f"; done
for f in $(git ls-files '.changeset/*.md' | grep -v hook-arm | head -3); do echo "== $f =="; head -6 "$f"; done

shellcheck --version 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo "---"; shellcheck --severity=warning -e SC1091 scripts/describe-defer-probe.sh scripts/describe-permissionrequest-probe.sh scripts/describe-pretooluse-deny-probe.sh lib/probe-observation.sh 2>&1 | head -40; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
